subtitle: Conversation backup and recovery
pending: Interrupted operation: open Tools > Recover operation.
allresult: Review incomplete items; missing folders are not backups.
shared: Includes the editor profile and other extensions. Restore replaces the entire folder.
candidate: Candidate paths: check files in diagnostics. Complete history not validated.
localonly: Local data only. Cloud conversations and external projects are not downloaded.
closeapp: Save your work. Backup and restore automatically close the selected app and its associated editors/agents, forcing remaining processes. AntiGravity native repair keeps its open-and-idle workflow.
portable: To move the vault, copy its entire folder, including App, App/Locales, App/Catalog.json and Backups.
privacy: Profiles may contain accounts and tokens. Keep backups private.
restorewarning: Folders return to the selected date without merging databases. Current data goes into a safety backup.
versionwarning: Prefer the same app version. Internal database compatibility is not checked.
customwarning: The entire folder is backed up and replaced on restore. Select data, not the installation folder.
technical: Menus and instructions are translated; technical reports and engine messages keep their original language.
repairwarning: Adds missing IDs only. Existing titles, pins and archived states are unchanged.
idle: Keep AntiGravity open with no agent running until completion.
restored: Files restored. Check conversations in the app and again after reopening it.
nospecificrepair: Other apps: restore from backup; there is no generic index rebuild.

locked: File in use: {0}. Close the application and its agents, wait a few seconds and retry. Backup was not completed; locked files will not be skipped.
busy: Application active: {0}. It may have reopened during the operation. Retry and keep it closed until completion.
codex_scope: Codex: conversations, attachments and indexes. Plugins, caches and temporary files are outside the backup and are not replaced during restore.
process_closing: Closing {0} and its associated processes. Unsaved work may be lost.
process_host: Open Start AI Chat Vault.cmd in a separate Windows window. Closing this app would also stop the vault running inside it.
process_denied: Cannot safely close {0} (PID {1}) with this Windows account. Close it manually and retry.
process_timeout: {0} did not stay closed. Stop any service or launcher restarting it and retry. No completed backup was created.
invalid_backup: Invalid option. Choose one of the listed options.
selection_cancelled: Selection cancelled. No operation was started.
page_hint: Tip: use the keyboard arrows. Right/N goes next; Left/P goes back.
restore_hint: Tip: a safety backup will preserve your current data before restoration.
